title: Implement an arithmetic expression evaluator (hard on purpose: tests decide)
prompt: Implement `evaluate(input)` in src/evaluate.js: an arithmetic expression evaluator for a string, supporting + - * / ^ , parentheses, decimals and unary minus, with standard math precedence and associativity. Throw a SyntaxError for malformed input and a RangeError for division by zero. Do not use eval or new Function. The tests are in test/evaluate.test.js; do not change them.
